name: Path of Power and the Inner Voice

pages.name: Path of Power and the Inner Voice

text.content:
Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

Followers (Unifiers) discard community, philosophy, and abstraction in favor of a single goal: power. They study why people obey and why they rebel, and aim to command everything around them - political, economic, social, and spiritual. Sophisticated Unifiers prefer willing service to fear, corrupting subordinates until they cannot imagine existing without their master.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to pursue mastery, or being too generous with rewards
  2. Showing respect to an undeserving leader, or failing to replace one who fails
  3. Showing weakness or fear
  4. Failing to use every tool at your disposal

Typical followers: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} (originated with Lord Marcus), now widespread as @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} warfare escalates; favors Dominate, Presence, Leadership/Intimidation/Politics/Subterfuge Abilities.
